dates.name: Pussycat Dolls & Kid Cudi — Summer Concert Weekend

dates.desc: High-energy summer concert weekend! Two legendary performances: Pussycat Dolls bringing early 2000s nostalgia with Lil' Kim and Mya, plus Kid Cudi's hip-hop greatness with M.I.A., Big Boi, and Dot da Genius. Electric atmosphere, iconic hits, memorable night under the stars.

dates.name: Grace Potter Concert at Red Butte Garden
dates.desc: Indie rock musician Grace Potter performs in the stunning Red Butte Garden amphitheater. Beautiful outdoor setting with blooming gardens, perfect June evening. Sophisticated musicianship and intimate venue make for a romantic, artistic date. Combine with garden stroll.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden Amphitheatre — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees vs. Tacoma Rainiers Baseball
dates.desc: Minor league baseball under the stars! The Bees take on Tacoma in a fun, casual atmosphere. Great food options, interactive fan activities, and summer sports fun. Ballpark energy is relaxed and perfect for couples. Perfect evening of classic baseball.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — 77 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Greensky Bluegrass Concert
dates.desc: Bluegrass jam band Greensky brings energy and musicianship to a summer night concert. Intricate instrumentals, lively rhythms, and devoted fan community. Great for music lovers seeking something unique and energetic.
dates.where: The Union Event Center — 465 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Arts Festival — Opening Night (Thursday)
dates.price: $18 (Thu evening discount); $22 (Fri-Sun); $70 (4-day pass); kids 12 & under free
dates.desc: Celebrating 50 years! 170+ artists, 200+ performances spanning visual arts, live music, dance, film, literary arts, workshops, and culinary experiences. Headliners: Digable Planets, Yola, Shakey Graves, Rubblebucket, and BANDALOOP. Free bike valet, Kids Art Yard, local food vendors. Download free app for schedules and coupons.
dates.start: Thursday 5:00 PM - 11:00 PM; Friday-Sunday Noon - 11:00 PM
dates.where: Civic Center / Library Square — 200 E 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees vs. Tacoma Rainiers — Saturday Game
dates.desc: Saturday night baseball with a fun, festive crowd! Enjoy hot dogs, local craft beers, and ballpark entertainment. The Ballpark at America First Square has great views and atmosphere. Perfect casual summer date.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — 77 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees vs. Tacoma Rainiers — Sunday Game
dates.desc: Sunday afternoon/evening baseball! Perfect family-friendly timing with relaxed weekend vibes. Enjoy ballpark snacks and entertainment with crowds that are fun but not overwhelming. Great for sports-loving couples.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — 77 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Arts in the Park — Lehi Summer Celebration
dates.desc: Local artists and performers celebrate summer at Wines Park in Lehi. Live music, art displays, community atmosphere. Low-key, artistic vibe perfect for an evening out. Part of Lehi Round-Up Week celebrations.
dates.where: Wines Park — Lehi, UT (30 min south of SLC)

dates.name: Lehi Round-Up Concert — Family Park Amphitheater
dates.price: Free admission (food trucks available for purchase)
dates.desc: Kick off Lehi Round-Up Week with live music at Family Park! Food trucks provide dinner options, community atmosphere, summer evening entertainment. Part of the larger Round-Up celebration with western theme.
dates.where: Family Park Amphitheater — Lehi, UT

dates.name: Lehi Round-Up Rodeo — Wednesday Night (Opening Night)
dates.desc: Professional rodeo action for 4 nights (Wed-Sat)! Bronco riding, barrel racing, steer roping, and western entertainment. High-energy atmosphere with crowds of rodeo fans. Similar to your love of sports events—thrilling, athletic, and exciting. Great western experience.
dates.where: Lehi Round-Up Grounds — Lehi, UT (30 min south)

dates.name: Derek Hough Live Concert at Eccles Theater
dates.desc: Broadway star and professional dancer Derek Hough performs at the prestigious Eccles Theater! High-caliber entertainment blending singing, dancing, and theatrical production. Similar venue and quality to shows you love (Phantom). Sophisticated, entertaining, memorable evening.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Savor The Summit — Park City's Premier Outdoor Dining Event
dates.price: $95 - $175+ per person (multi-course dinners at Park City restaurants on Main Street)
dates.desc: Park City's biggest outdoor dinner party! Long communal tables stretch down Historic Main Street. Top Park City chefs serve curated multi-course menus, craft cocktails, oyster pop-ups, and wine pairings. Live DJ, summer evening vibes, sophisticated and fun. Australian-inspired celebration. Romantic, upscale date night.
dates.where: Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (30 min north)
dates.reservation: required (many restaurants sold out; book ASAP)

dates.name: Lehi Round-Up Rodeo — Saturday Grand Finale
dates.desc: Final night of professional rodeo action! Bronco riding, barrel racing, roping, and cowboy entertainment. Saturday evening crowds and energy make it especially lively. Great athletic entertainment for sports-loving couples.
dates.where: Lehi Round-Up Grounds — Lehi, UT

dates.name: Bear Lake — Crystal Alpine Waters & Scenic Beauty
dates.desc: Pristine alpine lake with stunning turquoise water at 5,900 ft elevation. Perfect for your love of lake exploration! Peaceful paddling, scenic mountain backdrop, beautiful in June with wildflower blooms. Multiple access points, picnic areas, and incredible sunset views.
dates.where: Bear Lake — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north of SLC)

dates.name: Rockport Reservoir — Your Favorite Lake Exploration
dates.desc: Back to your favorite type of date! Crystal-clear alpine waters in the Uinta Mountains. June weather is perfect for kayaking, paddleboarding, and picnicking. Scenic viewpoints, peaceful atmosphere, perfect for exploration and connection.
dates.where: Rockport State Park — Coalville, UT (1 hr north)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Wildlife & Scenic Loop Drive
dates.desc: Drive the stunning 7-mile island loop spotting native bison, pronghorn, bighorn sheep, and desert bighorn. June offers great wildlife viewing and beautiful Great Salt Lake sunsets. Exploration date with incredible scenery and animals.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (30 min west)

dates.name: Little Cottonwood Canyon — Waterfall & Alpine Hike
dates.desc: Scenic canyon drive leading to world-class hiking. Cecret Lake (easy, family-friendly to an alpine lake), Albion Basin wildflowers, or challenging peaks. Crystal-clear streams, stunning mountain vistas. Your type of outdoor adventure.
dates.where: Little Cottonwood Canyon — 30 min east of SLC, near Alta Ski Resort

dates.name: Snowbird Hidden Peak Aerial Tram & Alpine Views
dates.desc: Scenic aerial tram ride to 11,000 ft peak with 360° alpine views of the Wasatch Mountains and Great Salt Lake. Walk scenic trails, have lunch at the summit lodge, or dine at The Cliff restaurant. Romantic, accessible, unforgettable.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — Little Cottonwood Canyon, UT (45 min east)

dates.name: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — Alpine Lake & Hiking
dates.desc: Stunning 42-mile scenic byway through the Uinta Mountains at 10,000+ ft elevation. Stop at Mirror Lake for hiking and picnicking. Peak June conditions with wildflower blooms and clear alpine air. One of Utah's most beautiful drives.
dates.where: Mirror Lake Highway (Hwy 150) — Kamas to Wyoming border (1.5 hrs from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Farm-to-Table Excellence
dates.desc: Chef Dave Jones' acclaimed seasonal small plates using local ingredients. Fresh fish, heritage meats, creative preparations. Intimate atmosphere, excellent wine list, sophisticated dining. Perfect for date nights.
dates.where: Handle — Main Street, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Mountain Canyon Fine Dining
dates.desc: Scenic fine dining nestled in Millcreek Canyon (4 miles up from downtown). Southwestern-influenced cuisine, stunning mountain views, fireplace setting. Romantic escape within 15 minutes of SLC.
dates.where: Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT 84109

dates.name: Dinner at The Tree Room — Sundance Resort Dining
dates.desc: Seasonal American cuisine in rustic-elegant mountain setting at Sundance. Farm-to-table ingredients, exceptional wine list, fireplace ambiance. 45-minute escape to the mountains with outstanding food.
dates.where: The Tree Room — Sundance Resort, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Dinner at APEX — Montage Deer Valley Steakhouse
dates.desc: Fine dining steakhouse with panoramic mountain views. Prime steaks, fresh seafood, sophisticated wine program. Elegant, upscale atmosphere perfect for special occasions.
dates.where: APEX at Montage Deer Valley — Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Brewery & Gastro-Pub Tour — Downtown SLC Craft Scene
dates.desc: Explore Salt Lake's craft brewery scene with food pairings. Multiple breweries, local artisan foods, expert tastings. Casual, fun, educational—great for discovering new favorites together.
dates.where: Downtown Salt Lake City — multiple brewery locations

dates.name: Broadway at Eccles Theater — World-Class Theater Productions
dates.desc: Since you gave Phantom of the Opera a perfect 5 stars, check the Eccles schedule for similar high-caliber Broadway musicals, concerts, and theatrical performances. Stunning productions with exceptional talent.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Utah Symphony — Classical Masterworks & Film Score Concerts
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performing classical masterworks, film scores, and popular concerts. Sophisticated, romantic, culturally enriching. Beautiful Abravanel Hall acoustics enhance every performance.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum of Utah — Fossils & Ancient Life
dates.desc: World-class paleontology museum with 60,000+ fossils, interactive exhibits, valley views from rooftop. Explore together, learn fascinating stories, perfect pairing with Red Butte Garden next door.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Red Butte Garden — Botanical Beauty & Summer Blooms
dates.desc: Utah's premier 150-acre botanical garden. June blooms are spectacular with wildflowers, cultivated gardens, peaceful pathways, and mountain views. Perfect for a romantic, leisurely afternoon stroll.
dates.where: Red Butte Garden — 300 Wakara Way, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Salt Lake Arts District — Gallery Walk & Coffee
dates.desc: Explore the vibrant downtown arts district. Local artists, contemporary galleries, rotating exhibits, public art installations. Great for conversation and discovering shared taste in art.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC (Main/South Temple area)

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Alpine Mountain Trails
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through scenic Sundance mountain trails with wildflowers and stunning overlooks. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides. Peaceful, romantic alpine experience surrounded by nature.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604 (45 min south)

dates.name: TopGolf Vineyard — Gamified Golf & Entertainment
dates.desc: Private bay with automatic scoring, full bar, excellent food. Zero golf skill required—just fun, friendly competition, and laughter. Relaxed, upbeat date night energy.
dates.where: TopGolf Vineyard — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing — SLC Climbing Gym
dates.desc: Indoor climbing gym with varied difficulty levels for all abilities. Great for teamwork, encouraging each other, and friendly competition. Beginner-friendly with instruction available.
dates.where: Red Point Climbing Gym or similar — Salt Lake City

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Puzzle & Teamwork Test
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive puzzle experience in themed rooms. Solve clues together, race the clock, enjoy the challenge and teamwork. Great for competitive couples who love problem-solving.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Mountain Biking — Park City Summer Trails
dates.desc: Scenic mountain biking through Park City. Multiple trail difficulty levels from beginner to advanced. June weather is perfect. Beautiful mountain views and fun physical activity.
dates.where: Park City Mountain Resort — Park City, UT (30 min north)

dates.name: Park Silly Sunday Market — Farmers Market & Live Music
dates.desc: Weekly farmers market in Park City with local produce, artisan goods, food vendors, and live music. Summer vibes, community atmosphere. Browse together, enjoy local food and entertainment.
dates.where: Park City — Sundays starting June 14, 2026

dates.name: Comedy Night — Stand-Up Comedy at Local Venues
dates.desc: Live stand-up comedy with great laughs and casual, fun atmosphere. Perfect for low-pressure evening of entertainment and shared laughter.
dates.where: The Wiseguys Comedy Club & other venues — Downtown SLC

dates.name: Outdoor Summer Concert Series — Free Live Music
dates.desc: Free outdoor concerts throughout Salt Lake and Park City during summer evenings. Bring a picnic blanket, enjoy live music under the stars, relax together. Perfect for budget-friendly romance.
dates.where: Various parks — Salt Lake City and Park City

dates.name: Hot Air Balloon Sunrise Flight — Bucket-List Experience
dates.desc: Magical sunrise hot air balloon flight floating over Utah landscapes with panoramic 360° views. Peaceful, romantic, unforgettable. Includes champagne breakfast at landing.
dates.where: Various launch sites near Salt Lake City area

dates.name: Historic Scenic Railroad — Dinner Train Journey
dates.desc: Unique experience aboard historic trains riding through stunning Utah scenery. Gourmet dining car meals, nostalgic romance, unforgettable views. Truly distinctive date experience.
dates.where: Various Utah scenic train routes
